sql: with agg as (select segment as scope, week, market, band, product, cast(sum(contracts) as double) as contracts, cast(sum(offers) as double) as offers from main.mart_segment_week where week <= 60 group by all), win as (select scope, week, market, band, product, sum(contracts) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as contracts, sum(offers) over (partition by scope order by week rows between 3 preceding and current row) as offers from agg) select scope, week, market, band, product, case when week < 3 then null else case when offers < 8 then null else (contracts) / nullif(offers, 0) end end as value, case when week < 3 then null else offers end as denominator from win where week >= 0 order by scope, week
